《roguedicer》是一部赌场风格肉鸽回合制游戏，我们可以选择不同的赌徒，在商店进行补给，带上芯片和道具，进入赌场梭哈。以骰子为道具，点数为力量，战胜诸多敌人，挑战最终的boss。 游戏的风格很新颖，虽然是肉鸽，但是做出了自己的玩法。 首先是攻击方式，摇色子，不同的点数代表不同的伤害。色子有很多种，不同的色子有不同的六个面，每个面的点数都是独立的。 在攻击敌人之前，需要摇色子，摇出不同的点数，选择敌人造成伤害。如果对点数不满意，可以重摇，重摇的指数可以通过芯片增加，或者局外成长的强化。 在局内，会随机出现商店，可以购买新色子，增加每回合攻击次数。每拥有一个色子，便拥有一次攻击次数。 游戏的局外成长分两种，角色专属或者通用，需要通过蓝色筹码来强化。 蓝色筹码的获取，通过局外商店接取任务，或者是用红色筹码兑换。红色筹码局内外都可以使用，蓝色筹码只能在局外使用。 红色筹码可以通过局内战斗获得，用处比较多，兑换蓝色筹码是其中一个，局内的商店全部要使用红色筹码，局外的初始道具以及芯片，都需要使用红色筹码。 如果担心筹码不够使用，右上角有一个锁，开发者留下来的外挂，可以一键筹码自由，同时还可以解锁所有的角色。 每一个角色的获取方式都不一样，可以根据提示去获取，可以使用解锁一键解锁。 游戏的整体玩法还是很不错的，立绘好看，风格奇特，比较值得体验。 [quote] 闲暇时光，不妨试试游戏。 欢迎关注[url=store.steampowered.com/curator/45653622/] 闲暇時光鉴赏组 [/url] [/quote]

I have about 8 hours in. All of my game time is on the Steam Deck (some not recorded due to being disconnected from the internet), runs perfectly fine with the exception of small text boxes that becomes difficult to read. They weren't kidding when the game page stated the game has "exaggerated body features and suggestive character designs, but nothing explicit," I full heartly believed it was going to be a throw away gooner-slop game and was ready to skip, but in reality... it's an actual enjoyable polished game, with an interesting take to "deckbuilding," the deck being a set of dice and managing how to use them, either for tanking or dishing damage, while finding various items for you and your dice. From the time of writing this review I've already had a couple of successful runs, unlocking various shops and characters (only missing 1 more) and I still want to play more. The game has interesting bosses that seem to remember previous encounters and having unique dialog every time you face them, which I enjoyed. Each floor has exclusive enemies that will test your dice build to the max. Definitely a "must try" and hoping the game keeps getting new updates with the new enemies, bosses, playable characters, and of course more dices!! (Now time to figure out how to recommend it to friends without looking like a creep)

I think overall it's a pretty nice game. The music is phenomenal, the art is fantastic, and.... I think that's mostly it. Right now it's just suffering from early access syndrome and it shows, maybe a little too much. I played roughly 3 hours of the demo (which mind you was a very short yet sweet almost nothingburger that was an okay sample), and it looks like thankfully all of my progress carried over to here. Unfortunately though, even with my progress, it seems like the early access version of this game (as of 1/26/26) is still pretty limited in scope. I feel like I've seen and unlocked pretty much everything offered here too in only a mere 3 hours. The only new character I unlocked was one where the severely limited RNG chances of the demo prevented most people like me from reasonably unlocking them with a pretty convoluted unlock method they have. And mind you trying to unlock them before this early access version took 80% of my playthrough time of the demo and then an extra hour give or take with this version to finally get her. But we don't even get an additional unlockable character to get, and again I've exhausted what feels and seems that most of this game can offer currently. I am not saying there is anything wrong with that, but I would wish for a little more, as that bit would go a longer way. Really the only difference here is that there's only 2 more floors which can only provide so much and are doing most of the heavy lifting. I understand the reasoning that other floors, characters, events, items, relics, mechanics, etc. are being currently worked on, but I have slight difficulty seeing why when the demo was released that there was pretty much a 24 day waiting period for an only slightly bigger game. I would understand less so why there is going to be a 6 to even 12 month waiting period for the full game too, but in defense of the devs, I know nothing of their current vision, so I will wait hopefully to see what the full version has to provide then, It just slightly stings because this year I could use another roguelite to help burn more time for personal reasons I will not disclose. Credit where credit is due though, the team has been doing a lot of great work during the waiting time in between the demo even till now to this day, constantly taking feedback and trying to fix issues with the game (even though it seems like there might be quite a few). The smallish community does seem to be nice, even if it is a little quiet at times, it's quaint and comfortable. Since the game currently is in early access again (duh), I was able to take advantage of the sale, getting this game for roughly $15. Now is this a purchase that is justifiable to one's own values? It's up for debate, but again, currently, I am left wanting more. I know that with these rougher times that there's probably a fair few people out there who would want to get this game but can't yet, and see that some friends of my own on here have wishlisted the game as well. Fortunately I was able to get this game without having to pay out of my own pocket since I've gotten multiple small bonuses, using one of them to cover for the cost of this game. Ironically, looking back at what I just wrote, this is my in-depth yet paradoxically not review of this game. In no offense do I mean saying that to both versions of the game, they don't hold much water, as was the demo a puddle, and this early access version is akin to a tiny shallow kiddie pool. At least this kiddie pool has the breasts of many sumptuously dressed big breasted babes breasting breastily together. I don't want to say "No" outright to recommending this game to others, and wish there was a neutral option for steam reviews. Because I can tell this has the merits of a strong passion project clearly worn on the sleeves of the devs, and it shows. So trying to put it as is right here- TL;DR It's a pretty good game. But still pretty short. If you still really are interested, go give it a try, it doesn't hurt and is decently priced (I guess) and will let you kill some time. I don't have a steam deck unfortunately though, so steam and many other devs, give me one and my life is yours to play many games and test them on it.

RogueDiceR是一款回合制卡牌类游戏，你将扮演一名角色，在形似赌场的地牢中闯过一个个关卡，收获筹码，找到那些隐藏的人员，恢复赌场曾经的辉煌。 本作的玩法具有很强的随机性，初始状态下我们只能操作一个角色，但随着我们不断的探索会逐渐解锁其他的角色。每个角色都有不同的特性，代表着不同的骰子。像我们的初始角色，拥有三个标准骰子，我们可以花费一次投掷机会来随机刷新骰子的点数。这些点数可以用来攻击敌人或是对自己进行防御，玩法还是很简单的。其他的角色在特性上会有所不同，比如说一个角色只有一个骰子，但她可以连续投掷四次，并且点数也并不常规。可能我们脸黑的时候连续几次都只有一点，这就非常看我们的运气了。在玩法上显然和我们的初始角色相差很多。每个角色都有一个被动技能，我们可以根据此来在商店中选择自己合适的道具。 本作类似于箱庭式游戏，每闯过一关，我们就可以在地图上选择一个房间继续走。在此过程中我们可能会遇到商店、休息室等等。在商店中我们可以购买消耗品或者永久性道具。道具有品质之分，但相应的，品质越高自然也越贵。消耗品不会消耗我们的投掷次数和回合数我们可以及时使用来回复自己的战力。每次游戏开始我们都会耗费手里的所有芯片，所以我们最好在出发之前尽量提升自己的实力。蓝色的代码则可以永久性保存让我们进行永久的局外成长。 总的来说本作的难度还是挺低，很容易上手，只是地图中依旧有一些没汉化的地方。如果对本作感兴趣的话可以试试。 [quote]欢迎关注鉴赏家: [url=store.steampowered.com/curator/37196866/] 稻荷窝 [/url] 只写我们喜欢的游戏 欢迎加入Steam组:[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/daohewo] 稻荷的小窝 [/url] 来一起感受游戏的乐趣 喜欢这篇评论，也是可以顺手点个赞哟[/quote]

At the time of making this review, the game is still very barebones. But has promise. First the elephant in the room. Despite all the lewd (and based) artists involved, you won't see any lewd content. There might be some update that adds optional content, but if will be or won't be the game's quality will remain the same. The game mainly involves building a strategy arround dice. Depending of the run you'll get stackable effects, dice with higher value, and/or passives. Obviously as any roguelike the more you play the more upgrades you'll obtain, as well learning all the technicalities. As said for now with three areas to explore there's no much else aside of unlocking upgrades and the shops in the lobby (And a few characters). If anything it might be a bit overwhelming at first (Or a lot depending of the player). There's dozens of effects to keep track on, both involving the dice and whatever the enemies might have. Some icons and keywords are common enough that you'll memorize in no time, but given this is a roguelike some effects might show up that you barely see or even use. There will be a lot of trial and error as you'll obtain an effect that you think will do some things, and then ruin the run because did something different. As said, there's still a lot of improvements needed such as polishing some menus. Soon or later this review will age badly as the game keeps getting improvements and content. But for now is at a great start.

《RogueDiceR》一款回合制肉鸽类游戏，出乎意料的有意思，游戏的音乐和美术直击我的XP，不过现在目前还处于抢先体验游戏阶段，明显感觉到完成度不高，不过在体验了几个小时下来，本作还是非常值得支持一下。 [h2] 游戏介绍 [/h2] 游戏的世界观都是围绕着赌博元素展开，要进行探险时也需要交付全部筹码才能开始游戏，在一个类似赌场的黑暗地牢中探险，里面的敌人风格也非常多样化，兔女郎、奶昔史莱姆、忍者还有魔法少女五花八门，看上去更像是个人oc的大集会一样。 作为肉鸽游戏，基本常见的机制内容都做进去，如局外成长、骰子继承、自机角色…还有常见的遗物道具和消耗品，整体游戏风格更像杀戮尖塔，骰子的点数也可以突破两位数，不像是传统的1~6那样，还能为这些骰子上贴子buff，整体的可玩性还是非常的高。 [h2] 好玩，但引导不足 [/h2] 虽然游戏玩法就是简单的扔骰子点数，骰子点数可用作护盾或者攻击敌人，再结合常见的肉鸽元素，击败敌人即可，但其实游戏的引导其实并不友好，索性我是接触过不少肉鸽类游戏，才能在短时间内很快上手，而且游戏整体难度还是具有挑战性，敌人强度高、战斗频率高，当只有拿到些红色神器遗物时才有可能爽起来，但其他时候容错率其实比较低。 [h2] 比DJMAX还低的汉化率 [/h2] 要说游戏最大问题，就是汉化率并不高，除了剧情文本和游戏物品的描述外，其他几乎都没有汉化，虽然是有存档，但战局内不能SL读档、战斗时也不能退回到地图上，在击败本层BOSS后自动进入下一层，所以挑战BOSS前务必先把其他区域都探索完毕。 [h2] 结语 [/h2] 目前游戏几乎在体验了3小时左右，就浏览完全部的游戏内容，闯关层数只有短短四层就截然而止，虽然游戏在局外做了非常多的内容，如商店、悬赏、骰子遗失，在局内不少角色都会触发游戏剧情，也有不少丰富的小支线，但奈何流程太短了，售价58单论游戏整体算偏贵，但对于如果有喜欢的画设，《RogueDiceR》算是小而精致的佳作，也期待后续作者能持续更新。 [quote]关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/36224058/]老实人鉴赏家 [/url] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/laoshirenLSR]老实人评测[/url]：独立游戏爱好者聚集地，黄油绅士交流中心。 不错过游戏的亮点，不放过游戏的槽点，带给玩家最直观的测评感受。[/quote]

缺点还是不少的。 一：层与层之间的数值差异很大，而且对初始骰子非常不友好。在没有天胡骰子的情况下，一层碰上精英怪就可能半残；二层打小怪就会大残；三层的数值简直不是人，没有天胡骰子很难过。 但要是有天胡骰子，打起来是真的爽。组了个全9+双重作用+轻盈口袋的骰子，配合syan重骰天赋，刀刀19点*2，无论打人还是起防都很舒服，已经可以宣布胜利了。 然而现在只有三层，天胡骰子还没爽起来就结束了，而骰子继承需要花费红筹码且价格越来越高，明摆着就是限制不让一直爽。可是一旦不爽了，进了三层就是赤石体验。 更何况，一旦买不起天胡骰子，就很可能意味着要拿初始骰子打。前面的积累全部木大，回归原初的赤石体验。 二：场外提升困难。首先，场外提升需要玩过几局后才能依次解锁，前期没场外提升完全是坐牢。其次，红筹码每次进入会清零，攒不下来，这就意味着红筹码不能靠无限刷，甚至前期留下来的红筹码完全会被浪费掉。同时，该机制使得每一局都要预留下一局的场外提升，不然拿到天胡骰子下一把没钱继承了就完蛋。而提升角色能力的蓝筹码的获取途径很少，任务需要通关好几次才能解锁，之后每一局最多能+8蓝筹码，其余的就只能靠战斗随机掉落，如果没有加成遗物，一局掉不出一个是常态。 红筹码除了买骰子还能买初始遗物和初始道具。遗物还可以，碰上有用的就比较舒服，但道具基本就只能用来一层过渡，放二层就完全不够看了。 但是还是那个问题，红筹码攒不下来。某一局倒霉，攒不下来红筹码，意味着下一局可能实力也跟不上。必须得一局小胡，然后留点红筹码，再赌下一局的大胡，如此滚雪球下去才能最终爽上几局，中间哪怕出了一点差错，可能就要重头开始，回归赤石体验。 三：地图随机性过大。两个回血要是出现在开门这一层直接丧失回血手段（同时一个节点就浪费了，毕竟现在只有回血选项），而一些需要特定道具的事件要是出现在商店前的必经之路上体验也会很糟。 优点是原画。但没有涩涩，真图原画不如去看涩图，没必要在这里花58买一坨史吃。 目前还是ea，希望之后这些问题能改好吧。现在这游戏就是偶尔能爽几把，大部分时间都是在赤石的体验。

This game has really good bones to be top tier. The obv way to describe it is that it's an anime esq, more in-depth dicey-dungeon-like. But the ability to modify your dice, and the motivation to both take OR ignore items with only clear downsides (I.E. increases energy cost of the dice) is so cool. Sometimes you WANT to spend as much mana/energy as possible on a single dice roll, or have a TON of bad modifiers on dice you dont care about and simply use 1 dice that gains power from those said dice. Its super fun and a good balance of risk/reward. HOWEVER. My biggest gripe is enemy intentions/specific patterns. For Example, Theres these nurses in the final area, while there's no direct intention description or status effect under their hp value, they will change their attack intent for a debuff instead after being hit multiple times within the same turn. And in a game where you more often than not will start spamming dice fast without paying attention, and didnt know this enemy behavior, you might end up targeting the wrong mob and ruin your run. The same isnt quite true for bosses however. They all have clear mechanics and intents, and pretty fun ways they make you change your playstyle from moment to moment. Overall, I can see this game having huge potential. AND since the metaprogession is optional, out side of unlocks, It can really appeal to those wanting rouge-lite/like fans. As of writing this review, 8/10.

TLDR: Finally, another rogue-LITE deckbuilder (that isn't lying about that) [b]decent but... indecent.[/b] Manages to be ok, despite annoying me. Glaring flaw staring you in the face while you play: You may have watched the preview clips and thought the character designs might be little bit cringe... Well [b]it's a lot worse than those imply.[/b] 90% of the characters have 3x endowment multiplier and are either chubby gamer girl OF fantasy, vegas strip club 304's, or as close to nude as you can get while still technically being clothed. And suspiciously white long skinny 'tad poles.' Not sure if that was supposed to be a joke, but it fails to land if it was. The other 10% are fine. Currently no setting/option to use alternate artwork that would make them less cringe (most of the models would take less than 5min to photoshop to something less trashy, so I see no reason they couldn't easily add this and gain more players). Gameplay is decent but [b]a little simplistic and a bit high on the random factor.[/b] Starting out a run, the dice are plain (with a variety of face values). The game is about upgrading their values, adding stickers that give the die abilities, and getting relics with significant effects. But it all does so in a very simplistic way: roll your dice one by one, use any available rerolls to try for higher numbers, then place them for attack or defense. Most fights don't offer more than that, though causing enemy abilities can be used strategically (or accidentally neglected/miscounted to your detriment) This isn't the clever play of Monster Train nor Across the Obelisk, it's a step down. But then, I've played those games a bunch and am looking for variety, so there it is. It does allow some power builds most runs... but you can also get skunked and wasted by a bad encounter. I'd say the rng is a bit higher than I generally prefer, but it does help make runs feel less samie. Vs something like Astrea or most other well rated dice games, the dice are much more plain, lacking the diversity and builds of abilities per face. Rogue-LITE: [b]Meta progress is actually there[/b] (unlike a bunch of the chinese clones of popular games that keep throwing false tags on all their games like it's youtube clickbait). Progress is a little slow, but chunks are a bit more meaningful (+1roll is a big gain). Characters have their own short level up chain to spend blue "s" coins to level up, including enhancing their unique ability. Then there is a general apply-to-all level up chain. Other unlocks include stores that use your leftover red coins (currency that will disappear if you start a new run) to boost the next run or meta progress: convert back and forth with blue coins (that aren't lost) buy dice from your last run into the new run buy relics (random selection store) Consumable items (and I don't know what else) There is a missions system for a minor boost to blue coins gain. But it's really just accept all, don't both looking at the text, because you'll likely complete all just by doing a run and certainly wouldn't risk a run for the tiny reward. It's definitely in early access, (placeholder options, characters, etc) but they seem to be going for a polish the parts before adding approach, so the game doesn't play like a garbled mess. No glitches so far, except 1 sticker not applying it's effect after an update (but was working the day before). All in all, it's alright and feels different, if you are prepared for how gratingly cringy it is.

Really wanted to like this game, even violated the general rule that you should never buy an EA game. Of course the big anime breasts and promise of roguelike fun is what lures people in, but the game is just very basic, and ultimately boring, even after all the 'content' updates. The premise is kind of cool, you have various dice you roll, and these are your attack or defense values, and can modify the dice. Even from this though you can see the gameplay is pretty dry, basically it'd be like a deck builder where every card is just a number value that is a attack/defense. No cool interplay, no crazy combos, not stacking buffs...just roll and attack/defend. As of now as well, the game is horribly balanced. Games scale up of course, but even level 3 of this game is insane, where unless you get absolutely lucky with artifacts you simply cant compare against REGULAR enemies that can kill you in a single turn at full health. I saw the anime titties and took a chance on an unknown EA game, and now just another reminder to never buy EA games.
